title: Asahina Mafuyu — The Honor Student〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This cookie is delicious.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks.
I've been really into baking recently.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Wait, you made these yourself?
Your homemaker talent must be off the charts!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Well, you're pretty good with needlework yourself, right?
I know you make things like pouches.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe, you're both amazing.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I'm just doing it as a hobby, actually.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Well, I still think that's amazing.
It must be nice to have hobbies...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh? You don't have hobbies, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm, if I had to say something... My hobby is keeping a fish tank, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Wow, you have a fish tank?
I think that's a great hobby!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Yeah, it really suits you!
What sort of fish do you keep?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Goldfish? Or maybe tropical fish?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Actually, I don't have any fish at all.
I was quite pleased with it after just putting sand and waterweeds inside.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Haha, that's one way of doing it.
I guess keeping live fish can be quite tedious too, huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Like when you have to clean the tank...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: The tank alone would work as decoration, so why not?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, the bell should be ringing any time now. Let's go back.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh, already? That was fast...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yahohoy♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Eep! I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it.
But try not to run around so much, alright?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Eek?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I-I-I'll be more careful!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Who was that just now?
Is it just me or was she trembling at Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Was she? She looked like a first year.
Maybe she was just flustered because she ran into an upperclassman.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe, you may be right.
Anyway, let's go.
Asahina Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm home.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, I was just about to go shopping.
Would you like to come along with me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Ah, I'm so sorry.
I have homework and class prep to do, and I'll need to study, so...

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: You're so hard-working, Mafuyu. Well then, let me prepare some delicious tea for you before I head out!

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Come downstairs once you've settled down a little, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay!
Mafuyu's Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Having a fish tank suits me, huh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why does it suit me, though?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
There's nothing swimming inside...
Of course there isn't. I didn't put any fish in.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It looks so lonely and comfortable inside.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But it's only big enough for an arm...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, what tea would you like to have today?
Ceylon? Earl Grey?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, I can't decide!
I'm coming down now, give me a minute!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll just pick whichever one is on the right.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting! I'll go with Earl Grey today...
Oh, there's a snack too!
